svg.text: 1. File lands in Boomi MFT (existing inbound pattern)
2. NRS authenticates to the MFT Files API
3. Request a short-lived pre-signed download token (authenticated, privilege: File Download)
4. Anonymous download, streamed straight into an S3 multipart upload (no S3 pre-signed URLs needed)
[ for each 100 MiB part buffered from the stream ]
[ stream interrupted, token not expired or exhausted ]
Verify SHA-256 of the stored object
POST /api/Files/1.0/{fileReferenceId}/presigned Auth: ApiKey | OAuth2 | Bearer Privilege: File Download
path fileReferenceId string, required Identifier of the file to expose
header ThruApplication string, optional Calling application name, recorded for tracing
header X-Thru-Tracking-ThruNodeId string, optional Originating MFT node, recorded for tracing
body endpointPath string or null Flow endpoint path: /{customerCode}/{flow}/{flowEndpoint}
body maxDownloads int32, 1 to 10 Times the token may be redeemed
body activeDuration int32, 1 to 86400 Token lifetime in seconds from issue (max 24 h)
path presignedUrl string, required The pre-signed token to redeem
header ThruApplication string, optional Calling application name, for tracing
header X-Thru-Tracking-ThruNodeId string, optional Originating MFT node, for tracing
header Range string, optional e.g. bytes=1073741824- to resume (returns 206)
returns 200 full stream | 206 byte range | 400 malformed | 404 unknown/expired/not found | 409 disabled
Response header X-Thru-Path: stored file path relative to the endpoint root
Points to confirm with Boomi / NRS
1. Does each Range request count against maxDownloads (1 to 10)?
If not, parallel ranged GETs become an option for large files.
2. Does an in-flight stream survive the token reaching activeDuration?
Size it to the largest file: 20 GB at 100 Mbit/s is about 27 minutes.
3. How NRS learns the fileReferenceId (step 2): event, SDEC message or FileList.
4. NRS is itself an authenticated caller, so the authenticated
'Download a file's content by file reference' GET (also Range-capable)
skips the token step. The pre-signed route fits when the download
runs in a separate worker that should not hold MFT credentials.
5. Retention / deletion of the file in MFT once NRS confirms receipt.
6. Network path NRS to MFT (DMZ / corporate VPC, public FQDN DNS).
NRS pull of SDEC attachments via Boomi MFT pre-signed download URL
API interaction sequence | Draft v0.1, 13 Nov 2026 | Alternative to the S3 pre-signed PUT URL (5 GB single-PUT limit)
1. Deliver attachment to the MFT flow endpoint
(mechanism TBC: MFT event, SDEC message or FileList API)
No Authorization header: the token authorises the call
X-Thru-Path: <stored path relative to endpoint root>
16. 200 OK object stored (multipart: up to 10,000 parts, no 5 GB cap)
Fix the request; do not retry as-is
18. 404 Token unknown, expired or exhausted, or file not found
Request a fresh token (repeat step 5), then resume with Range
Raise with the MFT platform team
Legend: solid arrow = request | dashed arrow = response | orange dashed = to be confirmed | red dashed = error response
